Jaleel's book had a mixed Thursday, August 13, with the headline mover being Adobe (ADBE), up +4.54% on the day — the session's strongest performer. The gain appears macro-driven rather than company-specific: easing oil prices and encouraging economic data cooled rate-hike fears, lifting software broadly, and M&A speculation around Workday (Silver Lake talks per Reuters) added a sympathetic bid to the sector. ServiceNow (NOW) (+1.85%) and SAP (+2.51%) rode the same current. On the positive side, Zoetis (ZTS) surged +3.13% and S&P Global (SPGI) added +3.07%, both meaningful moves for names that had been sitting in modest losses on an unrealized basis. ZTS in particular — down -3.7% overall — still has ground to recover, but today's price action is at least moving in the right thesis direction.

The drag came from RKLB (Rocket Lab), the book's largest single weight at 15.7%, which slipped another -1.32%. With an AVOID verdict and a QARP of just 39.7, price and thesis are firmly diverging here — the position is the elephant in the room for a capital-preservation mandate. Expand Energy (EXE) fell -1.66% despite a STRONG BUY rating, and Neurocrine Biosciences (NBIX) dropped -3.62% — the sharpest single-name decline in the book — against a STRONG BUY and an 81.1 QARP, suggesting the selloff is noise or sector pressure rather than a fundamental change, but the -7.5% cumulative loss demands monitoring. Lululemon (LULU) slid another -1.08%, extending a -6.5% unrealized loss that sits alongside a live guidance-cut risk flag.

To watch: NVDA reports a key risk update on August 26 (export controls / AI-capex sentiment); ADBE's next catalyst is September 10, where the AI-disruption narrative — not the numbers — will likely set tone. BSX carries a slashed guidance flag with the next read not until October 20, meaning that elevated-severity risk sits quietly in the background for weeks. Overall the book is up 7.53% unrealized, but the concentration of weight in an AVOID-rated name (RKLB) and several names with open risk flags keeps the risk picture uneven.

attention.headline: Largest weight carries AVOID verdict and bottom-tier QARP (39.7)
attention.note: At 15.7% of the book, RKLB is the dominant position yet scores AVOID with a QARP of 39.7 — the lowest in the portfolio — and is down another -1.32% today; the size-to-conviction mismatch is the single biggest structural risk to a capital-preservation mandate.

attention.headline: Neurocrine dropped -3.62% today against a STRONG BUY / 81.1 QARP — find the catalyst
attention.note: The magnitude of today's move conflicts sharply with the highest-conviction rating in the pharma sleeve; the drug-pricing policy overhang flagged across the pharma cluster (GILD·NVS·NBIX·VRTX) is a plausible culprit and needs to be ruled in or out before the gap widens further.

attention.headline: Guidance-cut risk flag active; -6.5% unrealized and sliding again today
attention.note: With Americas comps down five straight quarters, margins pressured by tariffs, China stalled, and the next read on September 2, Lululemon's BUY verdict is increasingly in tension with the deteriorating fundamental picture — the thesis needs a hard re-check ahead of that date.

attention.headline: Zoetis +3.13% today but still -3.7% overall — STRONG BUY thesis beginning to show up in price
attention.note: Today's move is the first meaningful price-thesis alignment for ZTS; worth confirming whether the session's gain was broad-market / sector driven or stock-specific before treating it as a trend.
